intro: 1 stick of aiskrim potong is about 120 kcal (estimate). The calories come from sugar, santan or milk, and flavours like corn or red bean.
diet: Yes. One stick of aiskrim potong is a moderate dessert. It's lighter than many cones or big cups of ice cream. It only becomes an issue when it's a daily habit or two sticks at a time. Enjoy one slowly, no guilt needed.
tips: Buy just one, don't stock up in the freezer.
Choose red bean or corn, they have a bit of fibre.
For something lighter, go for sirap-based aiskrim Malaya.

swap.name: Sirap aiskrim Malaya
swap.why: Same cold and sweet treat, half the calories because there's less santan.

faq.q: Why is it called aiskrim potong?
faq.a: It's made in a big block, then cut into stick-sized pieces. That's why it's rectangular.

faq.q: What are the most popular aiskrim potong flavours?
faq.a: Corn, red bean, durian, yam and sweet corn santan are among the favourites.

faq.q: Can I make aiskrim potong at home?
faq.a: Yes, with santan, milk, sugar and your favourite flavour. Freeze it in a rectangular container, then cut.
